definitions.gloss: generally; on the whole; as a rule
definitions.explanation: Used to make broad generalizations about a group or situation. Indicates that something is true in most cases, though exceptions may exist. More formal than たいてい and often used in written language or formal speech.

examples.japanese: {概|がい}して⟦{好評|こうひょう}→好評：16720_kouhyou⟧だった。
{概|がい}して⟦{日本人|にほんじん}→日本人：10112_nihonjin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{正確|せいかく}→正確：03372_seikaku⟧だ。
⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{試験結果|しけんけっか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{概|がい}して⟦{良好|りょうこう}→良好：13954_ryoukou⟧であった⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}える→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It can be said that this year's exam results were generally favorable.

notes:
USAGE:
{概|がい}して is a formal adverb meaning "generally" or "on the whole." It typically appears at the beginning of a sentence or before the predicate it modifies. It is more common in written language, news, and formal presentations than in casual conversation.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {概|がい}して + adjective/na-adjective + だ (generally [adjective])
- {概|がい}して + noun + ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ (generally, [noun] ...)
- {概|がい}して⟦{言|い}えば→言う：00515_iu⟧ (generally speaking)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {概|がい}して: generally (formal, often written)
- ⟦たいてい→たいてい：01129_taitei⟧: usually, mostly (neutral, everyday)
- ⟦{総|そう}じて→総じて：13845_soujite⟧: overall, in general (formal, similar register to {概|がい}して)
- {大体|だいたい}: roughly, more or less (casual, approximate)
